newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-CAPELLO TO RETURN TO AC MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-CAPELLO TO RETURN TO AC MILAN.

text.p: Real Madrid coach Fabio Capello confirmed on Saturday he would be returning to AC Milan next season.
"Yes, for sure," said Capello when asked if his next destination was the Italian club where Arrigo Sacchi is coach at present.
Capello was speaking after Real had beaten Atletico Madrid 3-1 to take the Spanish league title.
Capello won four Italian championships at Milan before moving to Madrid last summer.
At the beginning of May he announced he would leave Real at the end of the season, but had not made his plans for the future clear.
